note: 17 verified-unrostered targets from Sleeper's top-200 trending adds, Week 1 usage and Week 2 projections re-scored at full PPR (REST, cache-busted), cross-checked against all 14 rosters. Your WR2 starting slot is empty and Flowers is on IR, so one open roster spot takes Vele with no drop.

targets.hook: Outprojects Okonkwo, who has a hamstring, at full PPR
targets.why: Tied for Pittsburgh's team lead in targets and accounted for nearly a quarter of Aaron Rodgers' passing yards in a run-heavy script (RotoWire, Sept. 14). 5-46-1 on 49 of 67 snaps (15.6 pts at full PPR). Your starter Chig Okonkwo left Week 1 with a hamstring injury and carries a Questionable tag (nfl-events feed, Sept. 14).
targets.asset: 73% snap share, 5 targets; projects 8.8 at full PPR, above Okonkwo's 8.3
targets.my_team_impact: Starts at TE this week whether or not Okonkwo plays, and covers the hamstring if it lingers. Replaces Terrance Ferguson (31 of 61 snaps, 1 target, 3.5 projected).
targets.confidence_why: An established TE1 role with a full-time snap share; one game of targets is the only thin part.
targets.competition: haleymegert has Brock Bowers Out and is the TE-needy roster.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. 14 teams on 100 FAAB chase the thinnest pool of the three leagues, so expect prices above what a 10-team league pays.
targets.drop: Terrance Ferguson -- 1 target in Week 1; not a meaningful loss.

targets.why: Tampa Bay hosts Cleveland in Week 2 (ESPN schedule), a team Jacksonville blew out in Week 1 and that lost Dylan Sampson to a knee injury expected to cost extended time (nfl-events feed, Sept. 14). Sleeper projects 9.8, the best defense on the wire.
targets.asset: 9.8 projected vs 6.9 for your Dallas D, which hosts Washington

targets.confidence_why: Matchup streams are reliable on average and noisy in any single week.
targets.competition: No rival's defense is hurt; nobody has a roster reason to chase it.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. A DEF stream should cost the minimum; keep the money for the WRs.
targets.drop: Dallas Cowboys DEF -- re-stream by matchup next week.

targets.hook: Rookie at 91% of snaps, 7 targets; your first WR cover
targets.why: Third-round rookie played 51 of 56 snaps and caught 5 of 7 targets for 94 yards in his debut (14.4 pts at full PPR); RotoWire expects him to lead Miami's receivers in snaps by season's end (RotoWire, Sept. 14; FantasyPros, Sept. 15).
targets.my_team_impact: Even with Vele in the WR2 slot you'd carry two healthy WRs and no cover for a bye or an inactive, which league-profile-clash.md calls this roster's binding constraint. Douglas is that cover, and he's paid for out of the RB surplus.
targets.confidence_why: Full-time snaps, but one game from a rookie.
targets.competition: Six opponents carry an injured WR (nashsmom, brobertson2, hayhof, RBI11, haleymegert, kimberosburn), all with the full 100.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. The second-most-added player nationally in the thinnest league of the three; don't anchor low.
targets.drop: Kenny Gainwell -- 26 of 57 snaps, 5 carries, 1 target; the sixth RB on a roster that starts four.

targets.hook: Fills your EMPTY WR2 slot; 91% snaps, 9 targets
targets.why: Caught 7 of 9 targets for 69 yards and a touchdown (19.9 pts at full PPR) on 82 of 90 snaps; rookie Jordyn Tyson's hamstring keeps him out until early October (FantasyPros, Sept. 15; RotoWire, Sept. 14). Sleeper's #1 trending add.
targets.asset: 91% snap share, 9 targets; projects 9.6, the best WR on this wire

targets.competition: Same six WR-needy opponents as Douglas; hayhof owns Tyson and has the most direct motive.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. This is the claim that matters most on the board: bid what you'd regret losing, and if he goes elsewhere, the fallback is Mack Hollins.
